source: OriginalTemplate_R2 native PPTX; user endorsed direction, requested less clutter, lower saturation, better graph motifs, fewer formulas

changes.action: Lower blue/green/warm saturation, use neutral borders and primary-color accents only for focal content
changes.reason: Three competing strong panel colors and four source icon colors create visual noise.

changes.action: Replace ten-node circuit grids with six-node two-route schematic, consistent radii/edge caps and no crossing edges
changes.reason: Repeated large circles and arrowheads obscure rerouting.

changes.action: Replace four colored cost pictograms and two rollout pictures with consistent native line pictograms retaining their referents
changes.reason: Unrelated raster styles and saturated pixels break the palette.

changes.action: One central price-rule equation; objective and budget inequalities move to caption. Keep symbolic endpoint conditions as concise tags.
changes.reason: Teaser should express unification before algebra.

changes.action: Retain price combination and normalized priced advantage as the two main equations. Full projection, budget conversion and feedback recurrence move to companion caption/details.
changes.reason: Five modules should be visually distinct; algebra should be concentrated at the actor interface.
